leads.title: BLASTRUNNER
leads.author: creaturelab3d
leads.pitch_sfx: His atmospheric and punchy sound design would excel at creating the brooding tension and visceral impacts that are clearly central to BLASTRUNNER's horror and action elements.
leads.pitch_music: The game's intense, fast-paced action and oppressive atmosphere are a perfect canvas for his heavy metalcore, doom, and Argent Metal influences.
leads.reason: This game's described aesthetic of oppressive horror, high-octane combat, and intense atmosphere aligns perfectly with the sound designer's specialties in atmospheric, punchy SFX and heavy music.

leads.title: Evil Presence: Horror Game.APK
leads.author: rushgamesoficial
leads.pitch_sfx: His atmospheric sound design will perfectly capture the brooding, tension-building ambience crucial for a horror game like 'Evil Presence'.
leads.pitch_music: His heavy metalcore and doom metal styles align with the intense and aggressive sound often found in horror game soundtracks to amplify fear and action.
leads.reason: This horror game presents an excellent opportunity for his atmospheric sound design and heavy music to shine, despite not explicitly hiring for audio.

leads.title: Handle With Care
leads.author: Futuregames
leads.description: Inspect, stamp, and sort cursed packages before they drive you insane.
leads.pitch_sfx: His punchy sound design can bring the satisfying impact to stamping and sorting cursed packages, while atmospheric textures can enhance the unsettling nature of the game's horror elements.
leads.pitch_music: The game's theme of dealing with disturbing packages could be powerfully underscored by the composer's heavy and brooding metalcore or doom metal style, amplifying the tension and psychological horror.
leads.reason: The game's premise of dealing with 'cursed packages' and the 'horror' tag strongly suggests a need for both immersive, tension-building atmosphere and impactful, satisfying SFX, aligning perfectly with the sound designer's core strengths.

leads.title: THE INFIRMARY
leads.author: ORB RESEARCH & BROADCASTING
leads.pitch_sfx: His atmospheric and punchy sound design, honed on games like Elden Ring, would perfectly capture the unsettling and impactful audio experience needed for a horror game set in purgatory.
leads.pitch_music: The composer's expertise in metalcore, doom, and Argent metal would provide the intense, brooding, and heavy musical backbone essential for a 'Life & Death from the Purgatory' horror experience.
leads.reason: This horror game set in purgatory is an excellent fit for the sound designer's atmospheric and heavy music specialties, suggesting a strong demand for his unique skillset.

leads.title: Employee Exit Survey
leads.author: medianeutek1
leads.description: An HR exit form that knows you're not leaving.
leads.pitch_sfx: His brooding, tension-building atmospheric sound design would excel at creating the unsettling and unnerving audio environment befitting a psychological horror game where an HR exit form knows more than it should.
leads.reason: The game's horror theme aligns well with the sound designer's atmospheric and tension-building capabilities, though the lack of explicit hiring for audio and the game's described nature suggests a lower priority for music.

leads.pitch_sfx: While the game might not require FromSoftware-level atmosphere, his punchy SFX could add satisfying impact to interactions within the remake.
leads.reason: The game's description and genre (a remake of an 'sb3:>' with a horror tag) suggest a niche and potentially low-budget project, making a strong fit for heavy music unlikely.
